mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4.0% signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <50% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS <4.0% over a 2-year period, or the 20d returns are not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a t-test against a baseline of FEDFUNDS <4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals labor market weakening, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in >60% of instances where UNRATE <4.0%, or the returns are not statistically significant (p>0.05) against a baseline of UNRATE <4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) above their 5-year averages creates a synergistic demand shock, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p<0.05) in 70% of instances where both GDPC1 >10% and HOUST >500, or the returns are negative despite the combined signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the INDPRO supply index below 110 signals weakening business conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances where INDPRO <110, or the returns are not statistically significant (p>0.05) against a baseline of INDPRO <110.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'monetary tightening cycle', a rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals policy tightening, increasing discount rates on equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (p<0.05) in >70% of instances where FEDFUNDS >4.5% during a tightening cycle, or the returns are positive despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: Consistent monthly increases in employment (PAYEMS) above the 5-year average boost consumer spending and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p<0.05) in >80% of instances where PAYEMS >5-year average, or the returns are negative despite the employment trend.

mechanism_narrative: Strong growth in both GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 10% triggers a demand-driven equity rally, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p<0.05) in >70% of instances where both GDPC1 >10% and RSAFS >1M, or the returns are negative despite the combined signal.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in the INDPRO supply index below 110 for three consecutive months signals structural supply constraints, reducing corporate margins and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (p<0.05) in >80% of instances where INDPRO <110 for 3 months, or the returns are positive despite the prolonged weak supply.
